snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

snippet.title: MOBLAND Season 2 Episode 6 Trailer Explained
snippet.description:
I review, breakdown and explain Mobland Season 2 Episode 6 trailer. I give my theories and predictions on the next episode following the episode 6 preview trailer for the Guy Ritchie Paramount Plus show starring Tom Hardy, Pierce Brosnan, Helen Mirren and Paddy Considine. I give my reaction to Harry warning Maeve after he saved Eddie and Gina from Medusa, the Harrigans fleeing the country following Frankie and Kat MacAllister’s ambush, Eddie living in the shadow of the Harrigan name, Donnie going after Jan and other characters such as Gina, Conrad, Kevin, Seraphina, Colin Tattersall, Zosia and Bella.

snippet.title: Shrek 2 Remastered - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch this trailer in 1080p here : https://youtu.be/z8lViU0OlpQ

Trailer music : 🇫🇷 Pineapple - Fantasy


Wishlist Shrek 2 Remastered on XBOX Series X|S here: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/shrek-2-remastered/9pcw6x6zqp4z/0010


Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

Travel back to a nostalgic era of gaming for some pick-up-and-play casual fun.



Developed by Aspyr Media, Inc.

snippet.title: Dean Martin Had a Way of Making Every Song His Own | “Things” Live on The Dean Martin Show
snippet.description:
Dean Martin Had a Way of Making Every Song His Own | “Things” Live on The Dean Martin Show

Subscribe to Dean Martin's YouTube to get notified about the latest updates: https://DeanMartin.lnk.to/YTSubscribeID 

Dean Martin brings his signature effortless charm to this live television performance of "Things," broadcast on NBC’s The Dean Martin Show. Originally written and released as a hit by Bobby Darin in 1962, the track perfectly suited Martin’s relaxed, country-tinged vocal style. While Martin famously recorded a popular duet version of the song with Nancy Sinatra for her Emmy-winning 1967 television special Movin' with Nancy, his solo renditions on his own variety series highlighted his ability to casually reinvent contemporary pop hits. Accompanied by musical director Les Brown and His Band of Renown, Martin transforms the bouncy rhythm of Darin’s original into a classic piece of traditional pop, tailored entirely to his own laid-back persona.
 
Follow Dean Martin:  
➣ TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@deanmartin  
➣ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/deanmartinofficial/ 
➣ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DeanMartin    
➣ X: https://twitter.com/kingofcool 
➣ Website: https://www.deanmartin.com

Running from 1965 to 1974, The Dean Martin Show was a defining staple of classic variety television and a Thursday night ratings anchor for NBC. Helmed by producer-director Greg Garrison, the series was uniquely engineered around Martin’s legendary improvisational ease, famously requiring minimal rehearsals and leaning into spontaneous moments. The broadcast era coincided with a massive recording resurgence for Martin at Reprise Records. Teaming with producer Jimmy Bowen on hit 1960s albums like Welcome to My World and Gentle on My Mind, Martin routinely bridged the gap between Las Vegas showroom crooning and Nashville country-pop—a highly successful stylistic crossover that was mirrored in his weekly television performances.

Beyond Martin’s solo musical numbers, the program served as a prime-time gathering place for the era's biggest entertainers. The series regularly featured appearances by Rat Pack peers like Frank Sinatra and Sammy Davis Jr., Hollywood legends such as John Wayne and Jimmy Stewart, and comedy fixtures including Bob Newhart, Don Rickles, and Bob Hope. By blending high-caliber musical arrangements with unscripted comedy and a casual lounge atmosphere, Martin created one of the most enduring programs in broadcast history, keeping his catalog at the forefront of American pop culture throughout the decade.
 
#DeanMartin #Things #DeanMartinShow

snippet.title: RAMAYANA: RISE OF A LEGEND Trailer 2 Reaction! | Ranbir Kapoor | Yash | Sai Pallavi | Namit Malhotra
snippet.description:
Achara and Brandon react to the breathtaking Ramayana trailer, an awe-inspiring glimpse into one of India's greatest epics brought to life on an unprecedented cinematic scale. Showcasing stunning visuals, emotionally charged moments, epic battles, and a powerful score, the trailer raises the excitement even further as it teases the timeless journey of Lord Ram, the rise of Ravana, and the ultimate clash between dharma and adharma. Every frame promises a visually spectacular and emotionally unforgettable theatrical experience.

The film features an extraordinary cast including Ranbir Kapoor (Brahmāstra, Sanju), Sai Pallavi (Premam, Love Story), Yash (KGF, Toxic), Sunny Deol (Gadar, Border), and Ravi Dubey (Jamai Raja, Matsya Kaand), with visionary producer Namit Malhotra leading this ambitious adaptation. The epic is further elevated by the legendary musical collaboration of Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman, creating one of the most anticipated cinematic events in Indian cinema.

CALL OF DUTY: MODERN WARFARE 4 Full Gameplay Walkthrough / No Commentary【FULL GAME】4K Ultra HD includes the full story, ending and final boss of the game. The game was played, recorded and edited by Gamer’s Little Playground team. We recorded the game in 4K 60FPS on the Playstation 5 Pro. The video also includes all cutscenes, final boss, all bosses, no commentary, all missions and all cinematics.

🌟 DESCRIPTION🌟

00:00 Modern Warfare Story Recap

04:22:52 Mission 13 - Escape (North Korea)
04:38:52 Mission 14 - Entrenched (South Korea)
05:02:35  Mission 15 -- Decapitation (North Korea)
05:20:39 Mission 16 - Greater Good


Modern Warfare 4's story is centered on two protagonists: Private Park Hyun-Jun a South Korean Marine recruit who fights alongside his squad "Sierra-1" to protect his home, as an invasion of the Korean Peninsula by the Korean People's Army (KPA) threatens to destabilize the world; and Captain John Price the former leader of Task Force 141 who is on the run following his assassination of United States General Herschel Shepherd. As Park and Price each deal with their own conflict, another threat looms as a powerful weapon is being delivered to a mysterious individual known only as "the Archer".

snippet.description:
Mariah Carey - Loverboy Remix (4K Official Music Video)

Watch the official music video for Mariah Carey’s “Loverboy Remix,” featuring Da Brat, Ludacris, Shawnna and Twenty II, restored in true 4K from the original 35mm film for Glitter’s 25th anniversary.

For the first time since its original release in 2001, the video is available in digital format and on streaming platforms.

Music Credits
Featuring Da Brat, Ludacris, Shawnna and Twenty II
Written by Mariah Carey, Larry Blackmon, Thomas Jenkins, Da Brat, Ludacris, Shawnna and Twenty II
Produced by Mariah Carey and DJ Clark Kent

Listen to “The Greatest Show On Earth” : http://u2.lnk.to/TheGreatestShowOnEarth

Lyrics: 

If I couldn’t sing
How love’s the hardest easy thing
And if I couldn’t sing you my life
Hiding here in the spotlight
And if you couldn’t hear me
If I couldn’t feel
If I couldn’t feel your touch again
When nerve ends fray
And there’s nothing to say
Not even a prayer
It’s a beautiful night somewhere
 
Ohhh ohhh
If I couldn’t say it now
Tell me how
If this is love and love is all we’ve got
You can show me what it is
I can show you what it’s not
If this is love don’t act surprised when you get hurt
Even if our dreams lay in the dirt
We were once the greatest show on earth
 
Is that a smile or a tear?
Is it all show business here?
The cinema that is stained glass
You’re at the altar at our wedding mass
Is this a church of love or fear?
Have we made God feel like a stranger here?
 
Ohhh ohhh
Say it now
Tell me how
If this is love and love is all we’ve got
You can show me what it is
I can show you what it’s not
If this is love, we make cathedrals of our hurt
People digging their dreams out of the dirt
We were once the greatest show on earth
 
Love is a business that works at night
I sold myself for less than was right
You taught me what I was worth
In the greatest show on earth
Made a profession out of breaking your heart
You call it lies, I call it art
I was some of your best work
We were once the greatest show on earth
Love is a business you shouldn’t trust
Breathe on me and I’m love and I’m lust
Forever or a flirt?
The greatest show on earth
The light scatters things can get worse
These dark matters of the universe
Could not compete with us
We were once the greatest show on earth

Plants Vs Zombies Fusion is a Chinese fan made game that takes the original PvZ, and gives you the ability to fuse plants together. Many think that it's one of the hardest mods in PvZ history, but this is actually untrue. As PvZ Fusion is actually a fan game, not a mod. The difference being that PvZ Fusion is built from the ground up in its own engine, and is not just a modification of the original game. Though I did play this on Max Difficulty, so it was soul crushingly hard. Some may even call it one of the weirdest PvZ games, but I believe it to be a MASTERPIECE.

Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the the weapons of Grand Theft Auto 4, including the Sawed-Off Shotgun from The Lost & The Damned, the destructive Automatic Shotgun, and the chaos-inducing Rocket Launcher!

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is an upcoming first-person shooter game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision. It is the twenty-third installment in the Call of Duty series and the fourth and final entry in the rebooted Modern Warfare sub-series, following Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III (2023). It is set to be released on October 23, 2026, for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be a first-person shooter video game. It will comprise three main game modes: a single-player campaign mode; a competitive multiplayer component; and the extraction shooter mode "DMZ", returning from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022).Modern Warfare 4's campaign will have a focus on a war between North and South Korea. In addition to Korea, missions will also take place in various locations such as New York, Paris, and Mumbai.

It will comprise three main game modes: a single-player campaign mode; a competitive multiplayer component; and the extraction shooter mode "DMZ", returning from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II (2022).Modern Warfare 4's campaign will have a focus on a war between North and South Korea. In addition to Korea, missions will also take place in various locations such as New York, Paris, and Mumbai.

snippet.title: I Survived 100 Days In Minecraft's New Dimension
snippet.description:
minecraft's 4th dimension is kinda insane...

I conquered Minecraft's 4th dimension, The Sift. At Minecraft Live, Mojang just announced that a new dimension called The Sift is coming to the game for the first time since The End was released in 2011. And there's already a mod that replicates Mojang's vision for The Sift, adding new blocks, mobs, biomes, and even a new armor and tool tier that's better than netherite. So, I decided to try surviving 100 days in this mod, explore The Sift, get full siftite armor and tools, complete every Sift advancement, and defeat the new boss, the Twisted Warden.

Mielon's The Sift ➤ https://modrinth.com/mod/mielons-the-sift
The Swift ➤ https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-swift

subscribe for more videos :)
